title: Kissed Dry Norwegian Beet Hash
description: A traditional Norwegian dish featuring beets, this recipe is a paleo-friendly, resinous, and flaky hangover cure. It is typically served on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine diced beets, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, heat coconut oil over medium heat and add the beet mixture.
Cook the beet mixture for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is tender and lightly browned.
Stir in apple cider vinegar and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently to combine with the beet mixture.
Remove the hot stone plate from the oven and carefully transfer the beet and egg mixture to the plate.
Return the plate to the oven and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through.
Remove the plate from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
